result.markdown: --- title: "[list_datasets()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-function}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Return a list of all built-in datasets with their metadata. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/whittaker/blob/main/whittaker/datasets.py#L94-L111){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python list_datasets() ``` ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [list[dict[str, str]]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Each entry has keys `name`, `description`, `variables`, `family`, and `note`. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} ::: {#8fdfb04f .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import whittaker as wk rows = wk.list_datasets() [r["name"] for r in rows] ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` ['mcycle', 'co2', 'fish', 'credit', 'wages', 'proportions', 'meuse', 'survival', 'abalone', 'climate'] ``` ::: :::
